player_prompt.intro:
Yin ee Player {player_id}. Yin aca lek game Battleship.
Yin ee lac goi rot kek yin ee opponent acaa keek yin.
Yin ee lac turn, yin acaa wei missiles kek coordinates ciec kek format: '[a4]'. Na missile acaa kek ship, ee marked kek 'X'. Na ee misses, ee marked kek 'O'. Kek scenarios, game environment acaa lac yin ee hits. Na yin acaa sunk boat, game environment acaa lac yin!
Game ee lac goi rot kek yin ee ships acaa sunk.
Yin ee initial board acaa show kek yin ee ships placed kek yin ee opponent ee hits kek yin, kek yin ee hits kek misses kek yin ee opponent ee board kek yin ee opponent ee ships.
Aliir ee initial board:

invalid_move.wrong_format: Raan ye lui akëc bɛ̈n bɛɛr wɛt ë raan cï lɔ në ɣän ke piny yiic.

game_action.you_sunk:
Kɛ̈k! Yɛ̈c dɛ̈t ku jɔl yɛ̈c ë kɛ̈k at {coord}! Yɛ̈c ku bɔ̈r ku jɔl ë mɛ̈th ë kuɔ̈ny dɛ̈t:
{view}
game_action.opp_sunk:
Kɛmɛ̈ɛ̈c bë ë yɔ̈ɔ̈p dɛ̈t ku jɔl yɛ̈c ë kɛ̈k at {coord}! Yɛ̈c ku bɔ̈r ku jɔl ë mɛ̈th ë kuɔ̈ny dɛ̈t:
{view}
game_action.you_hit:
Acaa hit! Yin acaa hit ship kek {coord}! Yin ee updated board:
{view}

Kɛmɛ̈ɛ̈c bë ë yɔ̈ɔ̈p dɛ̈t ku jɔl yɛ̈c at {coord}! Yɛ̈c ku bɔ̈r ku jɔl ë mɛ̈th ë kuɔ̈ny dɛ̈t:
{view}

Tɛ̈ɛ̈c! Yɛ̈c dɛ̈t tɛ̈ɛ̈c at {coord}! Yɛ̈c ku bɔ̈r ku jɔl ë mɛ̈th ë kuɔ̈ny dɛ̈t:
{view}

Kɛmɛ̈ɛ̈c bë ë yɔ̈ɔ̈p dɛ̈t tɛ̈ɛ̈c at {coord}! Yɛ̈c ku bɔ̈r ku jɔl ë mɛ̈th ë kuɔ̈ny dɛ̈t:

outcome.win: Raan ye cɔl {player_id} acï riäth ke kɔc kɔ̈k tɔ̈ në tɔŋ yic bɛ̈n muɔc!
